title: Product Designer Senior
description:
Overview

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica, para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de Rio de Janeiro / São Paulo e Belo Horizonte.

Ao assumir o cargo de Product Designer Sênior na Afya, seu objetivo principal será garantir a experiência do usuário nos produtos, visando relacionar tanto os aspectos de usabilidade nas entregas, quanto aspectos de estratégia visando construir uma solução pautada sempre em feedbacks de usuários e em dados relevantes.

Você atuará na área de Product Designer dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, tecnologia e dados.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsibilities

  • Planejar e conduzir descobertas a fim de identificar e mapear oportunidades e dores relevantes dos nossos usuários e clientes, por meio de pesquisas e entrevistas com usuários;
  • Propor e participar da experimentação de hipóteses e conceitos, validando-os por meio de pesquisa com usuários, testes A / B, multivariáveis, split tests ou outros métodos de validação, a fim de ajudar na estratégia do produto;
  • Colaborar na definição de indicadores de sucesso e acompanhá-los por meio de follow ups recorrentes, para apoiar as decisões e direcionamentos do negócio;
  • Usar dados no desenvolvimento do projeto para formular hipóteses e sustentar decisões de Design;
  • Facilitar workshops e atividades de concepção junto ao time para guiar o desenvolvimento do produto, a fim de ter uma troca multidisciplinar;
  • Executar e acompanhar processos de pesquisa com usuários, utilizando seus insights na construção e otimização do produto;
  • Construir e iterar experiências que estejam conectadas com objetivos de negócio e necessidades dos nossos usuários para alavancar a estratégia do produto;
  • Definir novos fluxos; criar interfaces usando nosso design system; criar protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade quando preciso; realizando o handoff e acompanhamento da sua implementação.

Requirements and Qualifications

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Portfólio que mostre impacto real no negócio e na experiência do usuário, incluindo cases de estratégia, simplificação de jornadas e evolução de produto;
  • Experiência sólida em UI Design, com cases que envolvam design systems, mockups, protótipos e microinterações;
  • Vivência em manutenção e escala de design systems, com habilidade para propor, evoluir e escalar componentes;
  • Domínio de princípios e heurísticas de design, boas práticas de UX / UI e proficiência no Figma;
  • Experiência em product discovery e no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em ambientes web e mobile;
  • Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e facilitar decisões de produto a partir de argumentos claros e bem estruturados;
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e KPIs, sabendo como usá-los para orientar decisões de design;
  • Mentalidade curiosa para explorar e experimentar ferramentas e tecnologias de IA;
  • Interesse em se manter atualizado(a) sobre tendências em IA e aplicá-las nos desafios de design.

Additional Information

GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.

Confira os principais abaixo :

Para o dia a dia :

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais);
  • UP na remuneração : PLR;
  • Multibenefícios : Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.

Família, Saúde e Bem-estar :

  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D'Ór : suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado :

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Academia de idiomas (AIA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

Diferencial para Professor Médico :

  • Assinatura premium do Afya iClinic e Afya Whitebook

SOMOS A AFYA,

O MAIOR HUB DE EDUCAÇÃO E TECNOLOGIAS PARA A PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em .

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia . #VemSerAfya

Job description

Estamos buscando novos talentos para atuar como Cientista de Dados em uma empresa de Software ERP Enterprise!

"Somos apaixonados pela inovação e promovemos a conexão entre os times para que juntos possamos trabalhar com maior sinergia. Nosso compromisso é gerar valor aos nossos clientes e criar experiências, para que as pessoas possam tornar as rotinas mais simples e fluidas com a utilização das nossas soluções e serviços."

Confirme sua participação no processo se inscrevendo no link a baixo.


Main responsibilities

  • Coletar dados de diferentes fontes, como bancos de dados, sistemas ERP, CRMs e APIs.
  • Integrar e preparar dados para análise, assegurando sua consistência.
  • Realizar análise exploratória e aplicar técnicas de estatística e machine learning para gerar insights.
  • Desenvolver dashboards dinâmicos e relatórios interativos em ferramentas de BI como Power BI ou Tableau.
  • Fornecer suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica com base em dados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de negócios.
  • Colaborar com equipes diversas para alinhar objetivos de negócio com soluções analíticas

Requirements and skills

É importante que você tenha:

  • Ensino superior em cursos relacionados a análise de dados, estatística.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau, QlikView ou Looker.
  • Experiência sólida em SQL para consultas e criação de relatórios.

  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Overview

Financial Advisor Careers at First Command:

Shaping Positive Financial Behaviors since 1958

First Command Financial Advisors coach military families in their pursuit of financial security. Our reputation has been built on shaping positive financial behaviors through face-to-face coaching with military families. We embrace time-tested financial principles and a client-first philosophy. We inspire and motivate clients to take the first or next step on the path to financial security.

  • 9 out of 10 of our Financial Advisors are veterans or military spouses.
  • With 165+ offices nationwide, many are located near military installations.

First Command is committed to helping military families get their financial lives squared away. Are you seeking a financial advisor job or wondering how to become a Financial Advisor at First Command? As we continue to expand our Financial Advisor force, we are seeking leaders who have entrepreneurial mindsets and a desire for professional growth. Your experience matters.

What our Financial Advisors do

  • They are the personal coach to our Nation’s military families and are focused on a financial plan that is constantly evolving to meet short-term and long-term financial goals.
  • They help military families manage day-to-day finances, build lifetime assets, and protect against the unexpected
  • They engage with the community to bring new clients to First Command, with the support of the local district team and Home Office.
  • They engage directly with the military community by partnering with local military organizations, military units, and other supporting institutions.
  • They coach military families on how to build a comprehensive financial plan that includes:
  • Savings/banking
  • Investments/wealth management
  • Insurance/risk management

What we offer

  • We have a specialized licensing and comprehensive training program designed for veterans, transitioning service members and military spouses to start and grow a successful Financial Advisor career.
  • We will sponsor your pursuit of full registration and licensing as a Financial Advisor using our tools and resources to guide you through the process.
  • You will prepare and test for your SIE, S6, S63, S65 and state Life & Health licenses.
  • Upon successful completion of the licensing phase, First Command may offer you the opportunity to join our paid training program with a local district office.
  • As you begin this career, your First Command Financial Advisor salary will consist of an hourly wage for 3 months, initially expected to be minimum wage in the state in which you are employed. After three months, you may transition to a salaried position that offers progressive incentives during for the remainder of the nine-month paid training period. The compensation during this nine-month training period ranges by state, $31,550-$49,300.

What to expect after training

  • At the conclusion of the paid trainee program, First Command may offer you the opportunity to become an independent contractor Financial Advisor with First Command, through which you can control your career trajectory and be compensated based on your work and the results you achieve as an independent contractor.
  • There is no cap on your earning potential: Your compensation reflects your effort and is based on competitive commissions, residual income, bonuses, and deferred compensation. The average compensation during the first year as an independent contractor Financial Advisor with First Command ranges in commissions and bonuses. The median pay for advisors in years 2-5 is $115,740.
  • We offer professional development: including progressive leadership programs through classroom training and annual workshops to help prepare you for future leadership opportunities.
  • Set your own schedule to manage work-life balance.
  • Portable career opportunities throughout the United States which allow your career to move with you.

Desired Qualifications

  • Military experience or affiliation
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Proven leadership skills

First Command has been helping military families pursue their goals and dreams through financial coaching and guidance since 1958. To learn more about us, visit Financial Services Careers | First Command.

Overview

Lucidworks is leading digital transformation for some of the world\'s biggest retailers, financial services firms, manufacturers, and B2B commerce organizations. About the Role

We are seeking a Product Specialist who will be responsible for developing materials and frameworks that translate product strategy and roadmap into clear, actionable insights for our customer-facing teams. This role sits at the intersection of product management, strategy, and customer engagement. You will bring our product vision to life by creating buyer personas, value propositions, and supporting collateral that articulate how our products solve real customer challenges.

The Product Specialist will shape the narrative around our product strategy, while driving operational consistency by creating frameworks, processes, and repeatable assets that keep product direction aligned with field execution. This role will work closely with product leadership, sales, and customer success teams to ensure our products are well-understood and properly represented in conversations with prospects and customers. The ideal candidate has a strategic mindset, strong storytelling skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.

To ensure fairness and efficiency, we kindly ask that all interest in this role be

submitted through the application link rather than direct outreach.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of the product portfolio, market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
  • Translate product strategy and roadmap into personas, positioning frameworks, and value propositions tailored to different buyer and user segments.
  • Partner with product managers to inform roadmap decisions with customer and market insights.
  • Collaborate with sales and customer-facing teams to ensure consistent and compelling communication of product value.
  • Create product-related resources such as presentations, customer-facing briefs, solution guides, and sales playbooks.
  • Standardize processes for how roadmap and strategy updates are captured, documented, and shared.
  • Deliver training and briefings to internal teams, ensuring alignment on product capabilities, differentiators, and release milestones.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert to support conversations with prospects, customers, and industry analysts.
  • Support go-to-market planning for launches by aligning internal readiness materials with product release timelines.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in a B2B software role
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to assess market opportunities and customer requirements.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities, with experience creating content for both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience building buyer personas and messaging frameworks that resonate with target segments.
  • Demonstrated ability to take complex concepts and distill them into simple, compelling narratives.
  • Comfortable working across teams and influencing stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Bachelor\'s degree in business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Competencies

  • Resourceful: able to proactively discover solutions, learn quickly, and adapt in ambiguous environments.
  • Collaborative: works well across teams and geographies, with empathy and inclusivity.
  • Organized and detail-oriented: comfortable managing dependencies and backlog grooming.
  • Customer-obsessed: listens deeply to user pain points and translates them into impactful product features.
  • Ability to handle confidential information

$100,000 - $137,000 a year

Your level is based on our assessment of your interview performance and experience, which you can always ask the hiring manager about to understand in more detail. Your total rewards package may include (but is not necessarily limited to) discretionary variable bonus, top-notch medical, dental and vision coverage, equity, a variety of voluntary benefits, flexible time off, various leave policies, and many other region-specific benefits.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and Maintain Data Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT workflows using SQL, Python, dbt, and Airflow to ingest and process data from various sources.

  • Practice Software Engineering Excellence: Follow best practices in software development, including version control, testing, and modular code design.
  • Work in an Agile Environment: Operate effectively within our agile development framework, contributing to continuous improvement and quick iterations.

    • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, dbt, and Airflow.

Job Title

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master’s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through : nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / AV concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Soluções, Startup
description:
Você gosta de startups? Tem interesse em computação em nuvem? Temos uma posição para você.
As startups são as grandes empresas do futuro. Estas jovens empresas são fundadas por pessoas ambiciosas que desejam construir algo significativo e desafiar o status quo seja para atender novos clientes ou para desafiar os atuais. Geralmente operam em um ambiente de escassez: seja de capital, recursos de engenharia ou experiência. É aqui que você entra.
A equipe de arquitetura de soluções de inicialização da AWS se dedica a trabalhar com essas empresas que estão em estágio inicial à medida que elas constroem seus negócios. Estamos aqui para garantir que eles possam implantar as melhores, mais escaláveis e mais seguras arquiteturas possíveis – e que gastem o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso.
Procuramos construtoras técnicas que amam a ideia de trabalhar com startups em estágio inicial para ajudá-las à medida que crescem. Nesta função, você trabalhará diretamente com clientes interessantes e os ajudará a tomar as melhores (e às vezes mais pragmáticas) decisões técnicas ao longo do caminho. Você terá a oportunidade de construir relacionamentos duradouros com essas empresas e se estabelecer como um consultor confiável.
Temos mais de 200 serviços em diversas categorias diferentes e é importante que possamos ajudar as startups a aproveitar as vantagens dos serviços certos. Você também desempenhará um papel importante como defensora de nossas equipes de produtos para garantir que estamos construindo os produtos certos para as startups com as quais você trabalha. E para os clientes com os quais você não trabalha individualmente, terá a oportunidade de compartilhar seu conhecimento de forma mais ampla, trabalhando em conteúdo técnico e apresentando-se em eventos.

Key job responsibilities
- Envolver-se diretamente com pessoas clientes iniciantes para fornecer-lhes apoio técnico à medida que constroem seus produtos na nuvem. Certifique-se de que eles estão gastando o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso;
- Criar planos, em conjunto com outros membros das equipes de contas do cliente, para definir como você ajudará as pessoas clientes com suas necessidades de nuvem;
- Compartilhar amplamente seu conhecimento técnico participando de sessões selecionadas, focadas em startups, com uma pessoa e em grupos maiores de clientes;
- Trabalhar com outras equipes na AWS (por exemplo, marketing, treinamento) para contribuir para a criação de conteúdo que possa ser entregue à comunidade mais ampla de startups em escala (por exemplo, vídeos on-line e outros conteúdos digitais).
A day in the life
Como membro do líder mundial para este espaço empolgante e de crescimento rápido, você terá a oportunidade de ajudar a impulsionar o crescimento e moldar o futuro de uma categoria de serviço que terá um impacto significativo em nossos clientes de modelo global de computação. Nossa equipe valoriza muito o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Não se trata de quantas horas você passa em casa ou no trabalho: é sobre o fluxo que você estabelece que traz energia para ambas as partes da sua vida. Acreditamos que encontrar o equilíbrio certo entre sua vida pessoal e profissional seja fundamental para a felicidade e a realização ao longo da vida. Oferecemos flexibilidade no horário de trabalho e encorajamos você a encontrar seu próprio equilíbrio entre o trabalho e a vida pessoal.
About the team
Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos empenhados em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos dez grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários, alcançando 40.000 funcionários em mais de 190 capítulos globalmente. Temos ofertas de benefícios inovadores e hospedamos experiências de aprendizado anuais e contínuas, incluindo nossas conferências Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) e AmazeCon (diversidade de gênero). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram os membros da equipe a buscarem diversas perspectivas, aprenderem e serem curiosos e ganharem confiança.
About the team
Experiências Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição do cargo, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.
Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que os clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.
Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curiosos. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.
Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.
Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir às custas de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar.

Position Overview

The Senior Application Analyst PB Install supports the mission of OCHIN through complex configurations to support the Epic applications within the Epic electronic health record (EHR) software for our member clinics. This role consults with members and internal staff to provide solutions that offer accurate, secure, and efficient workflows, with a focus on quality financial outcomes for our member organizations.

Essential Duties

  • Lead and manage multiple competing projects simultaneously, defining, delegating and managing build deliverables for themselves and other revenue cycle analysts as needed.
  • Perform complex build and configuration in Epic PB and PB Claims, external financial clearinghouses, and related products.
  • Serve as Subject Matter Expert for project scoping, technical design, and process improvement
  • Consult with installing member billing offices, identifying existing billing workflows, reviewing claim examples and provided regulatory requirements, and suggesting build solutions to mitigate potential process gaps.
  • Translate and design customized Epic financial build logic when standard options are not available.
  • Provide weekly financial updates and project status reports throughout the life of each project
  • Act as project and technical consultant
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively across role types at customer organizations, including ability to lead strategic discussions with executive points of contact
  • Attend go-lives, leading ad hoc decision-making conversations from the command or billing centers as appropriate
  • Perform complex build and configuration in Epic Resolute PB and PB Claims and related products.
  • Operate in OCHIN\'s Member Care Team framework as a key contributor to the overall goals of the team support model.
  • Lead working sessions with OCHIN members to resolve advanced and complex integration work orders.
  • Discuss and provide workflow solutions and ensure understanding of the system through hands on training.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on applications across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor other analysts on complex interdepartmental project work.
  • Document build specifications, team processes and complex clinic workflows.
  • QA complex builds, Quarterly Update (SU) modifications, and other work orders.
  • Collaborate with members from other OCHIN teams to address integration issues.
  • Provide elbow support to clinic staff during Go-Lives and Dress Rehearsals as needed.
  • Lead trainings and workgroups for members.
  • Develop and share workflow best practices.
  • Travel up to 25% to support on-site software installations at new member organizations as needed.
  • Assist Project Managers in identifying system capabilities.
  • Build, design, test, and document functionality of new system features.
  • Provide process improvements within your application or team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in similar or relevant role.
  • Bachelor\'s Degree (Healthcare Informatics or Computer Science preferred) or a combination of college education and 5-7 years of relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 2 applicable certifications/proficiencies with preference given to Epic Resolute PB, PB Claims, SBO, Charge Router.
  • Work history in Healthcare IT is required.
  • The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of experience as an Epic Applications Analyst , with a minimum of 3 years of experience in Epic PB and PB Claims application build.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong communication skills - able to communicate with both application and technical team members, as well as end users.
  • Consistently acts with integrity and accountability.
  • Process and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data-driven decision making.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and solution oriented.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% to support UAT and Go Lives.
  • Prior to moving forward to the team interview, all candidates are required to complete a 50-60-minute competency assessment. The assessment gives us insights into how your strengths, preferences, and work style align with the OCHIN\'s nine core competencies. It\'s not about passing or failing-it\'s about understanding fit and setting you up for success.

To keep our colleagues, members, and communities safe, OCHIN requires all employees—including remote employees, contractors, interns, and new hires—to be vaccinated with a COVID-19 vaccine, as supported by state and federal public health officials, as a condition of employment. Work Location and Travel Requirements

OCHIN is a 100% remote organization with no physical corporate office location. Job description

Na Atlas, temos pessoas apaixonadas, curiosas, questionadoras e ousadas, que buscam soluções de impacto para acelerar o nosso crescimento. Aqui, unimos tecnologia, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento, respeito e diversidade para construir relações significativas e duradouras.

Estamos buscando a primeira pessoa Product Marketer da Atlas Governance — alguém que ajudará a fundar e estruturar a disciplina de Product Marketing na empresa. Você terá a missão de criar os alicerces dessa função estratégica, conectando Produto, Marketing, Vendas e Customer Success.

É uma posição de construção do zero, com autonomia para criar, testar e escalar práticas. Reportando diretamente ao CRO, você será responsável por posicionamento, messaging, ICP e lançamento de produto – com foco em impacto na receita.


Main responsibilities

O que você vai fazer no seu dia a dia:

  • Construir a função e os processos de PMM do zero, com autonomia e liberdade de criação;
  • Atuar diretamente na definição da estratégia, em parceria com o time executivo, participando de decisões rápidas e da execução;
  • Desenvolver mensagens ousadas, fortes e persuasivas, que gerem conversão e engajamento;
  • Evoluir junto com a disciplina de PMM, com oportunidade clara de crescimento para posições de liderança.

Requirements and skills

O que estamos procurando na pessoa que vai fazer parte do time:

  • Experiência em Product Marketing, Product Management ou Marketing em empresas SaaS e B2B;
  • Experiência em atuar em diferentes frentes: conversas com clientes, alinhamento interno e execução de GTM;
  • Experiência em comunicar-se de forma clara, storytelling forte e presença executiva;
  • Histórico comprovado em conduzir iniciativas Cross-funcionais com resultados;
  • Capacidade de definir prioridades, resolver problemas e trabalhar com autonomia em ambientes de incerteza;
  • Experiência na resolução de problemas complexos usando dados (uso de produto, pipeline, adoção, entre outros);
  • Histórico e capacidade de influenciar decisões em diferentes níveis e áreas da organização;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade, com perfil colaborativo e gosto por ambientes acelerados;
  • Excelência em copywriting e visão prática de como Product Marketing impacta receita.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em fundar e/ou estruturar Product Marketing em empresas em estágio inicial;
  • Possuir certificações em Winning by Design, Reforge, PMA, etc.

Additional information

A contratação é em modelo de Cooperativa e alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Ajuda de custo em Plano de saúde;

  • Folga no aniversário e no aniversário dos filhos.

title: Educational Sales Advisor (Remote)
description:
Overview

Company: ZoniLive

Location: Remote

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Join ZoniLive, a multinational leader in educational services, globally recognized and currently expanding into several countries. We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Educational Sales Advisor to be part of our growth journey.

Job Description

As an Educational Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for leading the full sales process while guiding clients through our educational and travel programs, ensuring an excellent customer experience every step of the way.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Process Management: Lead the complete sales cycle using company-provided tools and software.
  • Product Advisory: Advise clients on educational and travel plans, including cross-selling, while meeting targets set by the Growth Management team.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure sales meet company quality standards (customer retention, minimal returns, accurate reporting of sales visits).
  • Prospecting: Continuously seek and develop new business prospects in line with company policies.
  • Customer Support: Direct client questions or concerns to the appropriate departments, ensuring high satisfaction levels.
  • Tool Management: Properly use company technology and documentation systems.
  • Additional Duties: Carry out other tasks as assigned by your supervisor or required by the role.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma, technical degree, or bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, or related fields.
  • At least 2 years of experience in commercial roles, with knowledge of selling both services (intangibles) and products (tangibles).
  • Experience managing both in-person and remote sales channels.
  • Proficiency in office tools and CRM software for sales.
  • Ability to identify market opportunities and effectively manage sales pipelines.

Benefits

  • Be part of a globally recognized educational services company.
  • Work 100% remotely with a dynamic, multicultural team.
  • Benefit from professional growth and development opportunities.

Remote Work Disclosure

Although this is a remote role, it requires exclusive dedication, discipline, and commitment.

  • If you are seeking to juggle multiple jobs simultaneously, this role is not suitable.
  • You must maintain a structured routine, high productivity, and strong communication.
  • A distraction-free home workspace is essential.

We’ve learned from past experience that remote collaboration only succeeds with self-discipline and full alignment with the company’s mission and values.

To succeed in this position, you will need :

  • A strict routine and strong self-management.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • A distraction-free workspace at home.

Workspace Requirements

  • Laptop or desktop with Windows 10 or higher.
  • Willingness to install MSQ security software and 2FA app on a mobile device.
  • Functional webcam.
  • Stable broadband internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • 8 GB RAM or more (dual monitors recommended).

Compensation

  • Monthly payment: R$ 2,211.67 (Brazilian reais).
  • Unlimited commissions.
  • Commitment of 40 hours per week on a rotating schedule, under an independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their resume and a cover letter highlighting their experience and qualifications

Location

Remote

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Masters or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts, e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles.

Required Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, supporting your journey every step of the way.

  • Second month: $4,000

In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
